closed_by_executable_counterexample: G0-01 NEGATIVE (no certify_fn): the transaction refuses before sampling -- zero installs and a pre-sampling refusal, not a silent uncertified install
G0-02 NEGATIVE (score vector): a 2-D vector fails closed with score_shape and a wrong-length vector with score_len -- and neither produces a step (no silent prefix scoring)
G0-03 NEGATIVE (identity mismatch): a certified plan hash that does not match the plan to install is refused with certifier identity bound, zero installs
G0-04 POSITIVE then NEGATIVE (idempotency): the first correctly certified install succeeds exactly once and a second finish() on the same ledger refuses with already_finished
G0-05 the three outcomes stay DISTINCT: an unverified rollback is counted separately from a real restoration, and a pre-sampling refusal is neither
G0-06a the composed certifier itself declares the quality/salability capability gap, so no "fully certified" receipt may be claimed from it
G0-06b NEGATIVE (budget): no registered C0 budget exists for the 64 dev_check states, so the budget question is BLOCKED/AWAITING_USER_BUDGET_RULING and must not be filled in by the agent
